title: Simulation and Analyses of Stage Separation of Two-Stage Reusable Launch Vehicles
author: Dr. Jeremy T. Pinier & NASA RLV Aero Team
notes: Authoritative methodological reference for two-stage RLV separation, proximity aerodynamics, and Monte Carlo clearance envelopes.
known_conflicts: Methodology reference only; vehicle geometry and aerodynamics do not represent Starship flight hardware.

title: SpaceX Starship Hot Staging — From Concept to Flight
author: Dr. Derek Liechty & HECC Ames Research Team
notes: Documents NASA HECC time-accurate moving-body CFD using Loci/CHEM (500M cells, 40M CPU hours on Pleiades) for Starship hot-staging.
known_conflicts: Demonstrates that full Navier-Stokes plume interaction exceeds desktop capability; defines boundary of L1 3-DOF model.

title: Powered Stage Separation Aerodynamics of the Ares I Launch Vehicle
author: Stuart E. Rogers & NAS Aero Team
notes: Details necessity of transient flow, time-varying thrust, and multi-body 6-DOF simulation for stage separation.
known_conflicts: Methodological reference only; solid rocket booster separation dynamics differ fundamentally from liquid hot-staging.

title: Development of Constraint Force Equation Methodology for Application to Multi-Body Dynamics Including Launch Vehicle Stage Separation
author: Eric L. Stewart & MSFC Dynamics Team
notes: Theoretical formulation of constraint force equations for separating multibody launch vehicle dynamics without artificial numerical stiffness.
known_conflicts: Analytical multibody reference; applies to constrained contact and separation release mechanics.

title: SpaceX's Starship makes orbital debut deploying Starlinks before early ending
author: Joey Roulette
notes: Independent news confirmation of Flight 14 orbital reach, 26 Starlink deployment, booster splashdown in Gulf, and mission shortening to ~3h due to upper-stage engine issue.
known_conflicts: Confirms actual flown mission profile differed from preflight 10-hour plan; establishes independent mission facts.

title: Starship's Fourteenth Flight Test Pre-Flight Mission Overview
author: SpaceX Mission Operations
notes: Planned sequence of Flight 14 including hot staging ring jettison concept, 26 satellite payload, and planned 10-hour orbit.
known_conflicts: Preflight nominal profile only; actual flown mission deviated due to upper-stage engine issue and shortened mission duration.

title: SciPy solve_ivp: Integration of Initial Value Problems for ODEs
author: Pauli Virtanen et al.
notes: Authoritative guide to adaptive Runge-Kutta solvers (RK45/DOP853) and event handling; notes event detection relies on root-finding across step intervals.
known_conflicts: Requires segmented integration at discrete staging events to avoid missing zero-crossings or introducing state discontinuities.

title: FreeCAD Assembly Workbench Documentation & Create Simulation Reference
author: Ondsel / FreeCAD Documentation Team
notes: Documents FreeCAD built-in Assembly joint kinematics and frame-by-frame joint driver simulations.
known_conflicts: Applies strictly to mechanism animation and geometric visual replay; cannot calculate flight trajectory or coupled aerodynamic dynamics.
